_README: The WA region-level tree, diffed by NAME against Mountain Project's published sub-area
lists on 2026-08-09. This is the ONLY thing that can catch the 0118 defect class:
MP groups a scatter of small crags under a container, our import dropped them flat at
region level, and Olympics & Pacific Coast ended up with 18 direct children against
MP's 10. There is no stub, no duplicate and nothing co-located, so every geometric
detector in audit:area-parents is structurally blind to it. Only an external reference
HOW IT IS USED. D5 in scripts/audit-area-parents.mjs asserts that every one of OUR
region-level children appears below, either in `mp` (it corresponds to an MP area) or in
`extra` (a deliberate divergence, WITH a reason). A child that is in neither is the
finding. It is an allow-list keyed on OUR names, not a snapshot equality test, so a
legitimate restructure is recorded here in the same commit rather than fighting a diff.
WHAT IT DOES NOT CLAIM. Not that we hold everything MP holds. `mp_absent` records MP
areas we have no row for at all - a coverage gap, not a parentage defect, and this file
keeps them written down so they are not rediscovered as bugs. And matching MP's
PLACEMENT never means importing MP's GRANULARITY: 0117 kept three Ingalls summit rows
where MP has one, because enrichRoute builds peakMetadata per area_type='peak'.
Route counts are deliberately NOT recorded. They move every time anyone adds a climb on
either side, so pinning them would guarantee a stale file. Names are the durable claim.

_mp_regions_we_do_not_mirror.Ice, Mixed & Drytooling: MP carries a discipline-scoped top-level region with 0 routes. We group by geography only.

wa_northwest.name: Northwest Region
mp: Hwy 20 and North Cascades National Park

wa_centraleast.name: Central-East Cascades, Wenatchee & Leavenworth
wa_centraleast.verdict: 0117 moved Ingalls Peak out of Teanaway into Stuart-Enchantments

extra.Chiwawa Ridge / DaKobed Range: our own alpine grouping; MP indexes none of these summits
extra.East Wenatchee: small crag cluster; MP has a differently-scoped 'Wenatchee'
extra.Orondo: small crag; MP does not carry it at region level
extra.Tarpiscan Road: small crag; MP does not carry it at region level

wa_centralwest.name: Central-West Cascades & Seattle
wa_centralwest.verdict: matches MP exactly after 0111 (Snoqualmie/Alpine Lakes), 0118 (Gig Harbor + Tacoma out) and 0119 (the 14 peaks redistributed, the duplicate 'Snoqualmie Pass' region dissolved)

wa_okanogan.name: Okanogan
wa_okanogan.verdict: matches MP; 13 of MP's 14, same names, no level error

extra.Riverside (Riverside): 0-route container of 3 empty crags; MP does not list it at region level and I could not establish where MP nests it. Left rather than guessed at.

wa_olympics.name: Olympics & Pacific Coast
wa_olympics.verdict: 0118 cut 18 direct children to 11 — created Kitsap Peninsula & Puget Sound Islands, lifted Olympic Bouldering out of the National PARK (it holds Jefferson Lake and Lena Lake, which are National FOREST), and moved Lake Cushman under the Forest

extra.Chimacum Rock: 3 routes; MP lists it at no region level I could find, so leaving it beats guessing
extra.Olympia: 2 routes; ditto — MP has 'Olympia Area Bouldering' but no bare 'Olympia'

wa_olympics._note: 'Olympic Bouldering' is our name for MP's 'Olympic Peninsula Bouldering'. Our Olympic National Park subtree (Bailey Range, Eastern/Central Olympics, ...) is OUR alpine grouping and is deliberately NOT flattened to MP's per-peak list.

wa_sw_tacoma.name: South-West & Tacoma
wa_sw_tacoma.verdict: 0116 dissolved a region nested inside its own namesake and lifted Columbia Gorge + Tacoma & I5 up one level
mp_absent: Waterfall ice and mixed routes in the SW Cascades

wa_central_region.name: Central Region

extra.Lake Lenore and Soap Lake: 0-route crag; MP does not carry it at region level
extra.Moses Coulee: 0-route crag; MP does not carry it at region level

wa_central_region._note: Ours merges MP's 'Banks Lake' + 'Northrup Canyon' into one row, and names MP's 'Ancient Lakes & Judith Pond' as 'Ancient Lakes Coulee'.

wa_northeast_corner_spokane.name: Northeast Corner & Spokane
wa_northeast_corner_spokane.verdict: matches MP exactly — our 5 children are MP's 5

wa_southeast_cascades_yakima.name: Southeast Cascades & Yakima
wa_southeast_cascades_yakima.verdict: matches MP — all 4 of ours are in MP's list
wa_southeast_cascades_yakima._note: MP names this region 'South-Central & Yakima', and names our 'Strobach Mountain' as 'Strobach Mountain Ice'.

wa_southeast_corner.name: Southeast Corner
wa_southeast_corner.verdict: matches MP — all 7 of ours are in MP's list
mp_absent: Holding Spot for Temporarily Closed Areas
